chair_assembly_puzzle.name: Chair Assembly Puzzle
chair_assembly_puzzle.description: Interactive puzzle where players assemble a Judd-inspired chair by scaling, rotating, and positioning cube pieces to match ghost guides.

scalable_wood_cube.name: Scalable Wood Cube
scalable_wood_cube.description: Grabbable wood cube with two-handed scaling support. Scale snaps to discrete values (0.05x to 4.0x) per axis.

attachable_wood_cube.name: Attachable Wood Cube
attachable_wood_cube.description: Scalable wood cube with attachment points on all faces. Pieces snap together when attachment points align and face each other.

snappable_wood_cube.name: Snappable Wood Cube
snappable_wood_cube.description: Scalable wood cube with grid-based face snapping. Faces snap to 0.05m grid alignment when parallel and close.

stool_assembly_puzzle.name: Stool Assembly Puzzle
stool_assembly_puzzle.description: Assembly puzzle for a simple stool (seat + 4 legs).

table_assembly_puzzle.name: Table Assembly Puzzle
table_assembly_puzzle.description: Assembly puzzle for a minimal table (top + 4 legs).
